title: Beavers first
prompt: Prefer eligible requests about beavers. If none are available, choose other wetland mammals. Keep all contribution and loop checks. Apply this order before each task; if both groups are exhausted, report that and pause.

title: Only owls
prompt: Only choose eligible requests about owls. Keep all contribution and loop checks, and apply this filter before each task. If no unclaimed owl requests remain, pause and ask before choosing another group.

title: Birds near home
prompt: Only choose eligible requests about birds native to Minnesota, verifying native range from sources. Keep the regions required by the issue and all contribution and loop checks. Apply this filter before each task; pause when no matches remain.

title: Frogs and toads
prompt: Only choose eligible requests about frogs or toads. Keep all contribution and loop checks, and apply this filter before each task. If the matching queue runs out, report the completed PRs and pause.
